name: buddie
description: Checks AI-generated answers against cited sources and execution evidence. Verifies quotations, GitHub pull requests, CI results, and session claims with deterministic checks, without another AI model. Flags unsupported statements and provides actionable feedback.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Used only for pr: and ci: anchors, sent only to api.github.com (or the GitHub API an administrator's protected policy names). Without it GitHub allows 60 lookups an hour and private repos can't be checked.

read_transcript.title: Read the session transcript
read_transcript.description: On: run: anchors are checked against the commands this session ran. Off: the hook never opens the session log; the final answer comes from the Stop event and run: anchors are reported as unchecked.
